about: Load, stress, spike and soak runs of deploy/loadtest/locustfile.py (audit stage S6, BVTGC-17). python -m grama.perftest <kind> reads this file and .env.test (git-ignored; copy .env.test.example). It refuses to start without a base URL, and against any host in refused_hosts. Staging only (BVTGC-38); user numbers follow BVTGC-37 once the client gives them.

refused_hosts.dev.bvtgramaconnect.com: the qa server: Django's development server without Nginx, so its figures mean nothing and the testers use it

optional_env.LOADTEST_OFFICIAL_USERNAME: a staging official for the logged-in mix (login, refresh, notifications, a draft post deleted again); without it only citizens and failed logins run
optional_env.LOADTEST_METRICS_URL: an address answering JSON {"cpu_percent", "memory_mb", "db_connections"} on the staging server, read every 5 s; without it server figures are not recorded

sla.about: The answer times and error rate a step must stay within (per endpoint where listed, else the default).

load.about: Each user count in turn, the realistic mix.

stress.about: From start, add step users each round until the error rate or P95 crosses stop_when, or max.

spike.about: 0 to users at once; recovery is the time until P95 is back within the SLA.

soak.about: Sustained load; error drift between the first and the last minutes, and server memory and DB connections when a metrics source is set.
